evals.prompt: Count the lights on this lighting layout and give me the quantities. Suggest motion sensors for the sculleries, ensuites and garages.
evals.expected_output: Per-floor counts of light fittings by type, LED strip runs, and switch positions, plus suggested motion sensors, in an xlsx with a tab for this floor.

evals.prompt: Do a lighting take-off on this bedroom level plan into a spreadsheet — downlights, LED strips and switch positions, and how many motion sensors for the ensuites.

files: 12 Mountain Road - Bedroom Level - D-One Layout.pdf

evals.prompt: Turn this basement/entrance floorplan into a lighting quantities sheet with sensor suggestions for the garage and scullery.
